'''Larbec''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Great Houses of Alderaan|noble]] [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Holding the rank of [[Private/Legends|private]], Larbec worked as a vendor in the market area of [[House Organa (estate)|House Organa's estate]] in the [[Apalis Coast]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where they sold heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. Larbec had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and fair skin. While working, the vendor wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Larbec appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Heavy Armor Vendor for Republic players on Alderaan.<ref name="SWTOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> they were removed from the game along with the rest of the Heavy Armor Vendors.<ref name="SWTOR" />
